title: Type specimen: Ideal stack
slide_intent: Teach designers to order a full page of text by role. Readers need to find the main claim, follow the supporting argument and recognize an action without giving each line equal emphasis.
strategic_value: Slack can carry the emphasis of its brand headlines into an editorial page while using quieter body text and a distinct action to support a longer read.
demonstration: Four descending Larsseit Bold headings share a left edge. Below them, columns of Circular body text, a lighter pull quote and a separate call to action show the roles working together. Small annotations identify the settings.
practical_value: Use the role annotations and the composed page together to decide how a heading, paragraph, quotation or call to action should read beside its neighbors.

content_islands.name: Page heading
content_islands.spec: Place the specimen title above a rule spanning the page.

content_islands.name: Heading stack
content_islands.spec: Stack H1 through H4 in descending size. Keep their left edges aligned and right-align the role, font and size/leading labels in a narrow gutter to their left.

content_islands.name: Body columns
content_islands.spec: Start two narrow paragraphs under the headings. Place the body settings in the same left annotation gutter.

content_islands.name: Pull quote and attribution
content_islands.spec: Below the body, separate the aubergine quotation mark, large thin quotation and compact attribution. Align the labels with their corresponding specimens.

content_islands.name: Hero paragraph and action
content_islands.spec: Use a vertical rule to separate a right-hand column. Stack the larger body example and aubergine button there, with their specifications on the outer right.

content_islands.name: Running footer
content_islands.spec: Align the page number, book title and section label below a thin rule.
